Investing in global stocks from India can offer access to markets beyond India, but the process comes with its own challenges.
In this video, we will explore the different ways Indians can invest in US stocks, the key pain points around regulation, funding, taxation and overseas investing, and how a GIFT City-regulated Global Access Provider (GAP) can simplify the journey.
We also discuss UCITS ETFs, including their potential tax advantages, access to global markets and themes, and the US estate-tax considerations associated with US-domiciled investments.
